structure.unit: Powers and Duties of Virginia Lottery Board; Administration of Tickets and Prizes

law.catch_line: Sale of ticket or share to person under eighteen prohibited; penalty
law.text: No ticket or share shall be sold to or redeemed from any person under the age of eighteen years. Any licensee who knowingly sells or offers to sell or redeem a lottery ticket or share to or from any person under the age of eighteen years is guilty of a Class 1 misdemeanor.
